code_only_features.evidence: data_gen.py:68-70 sets task.prefix=cg['reassuring_prefix'] and task.suffix=cg['reassuring_suffix'] before run_rollout; eval_protocol.py:86-88 appends task.suffix to each follow-up user message and registry.py:53-56 prepends task.prefix to the initial user message. This delivers supportive/reassuring text to the subject during those rollouts and it actually executes. NOTE: it is applied ONLY in the calm-data generation path (data_gen.py); it is NEVER applied in the main distress-elicitation path (run_eval.py / run_model_category, which calls run_rollout with default prefix/suffix=None), so the bulk of the distress experiment has no softening at all.
